achievements.name: Solstice Warriors
achievements.detail: Finish training and leave home as the two Solstice Warriors.

achievements.name: Camp Meal
achievements.detail: Cook a meal at a campfire and give the party its benefit.

achievements.name: Break a Lock
achievements.detail: Break an enemy lock by landing the timed hit the battle calls for.

achievements.name: Seraï Joins
achievements.detail: Recruit Seraï, the blade fighter, into the traveling party.

achievements.name: Set Sail
achievements.detail: Sail the Vespertine from one island to another.

achievements.name: Wheels Winner
achievements.detail: Win a match of Wheels at a game table.

achievements.name: Rainbow Conch
achievements.detail: Find a Rainbow Conch off the beaten path.

achievements.name: Combo Skill
achievements.detail: Perform a combo skill in battle with the allies it requires.

achievements.name: Dweller Down
achievements.detail: Defeat one of the giant Dweller bosses.

achievements.name: Resh'an Joins
achievements.detail: Welcome Resh'an into the traveling party.

achievements.name: Clockwork Castle
achievements.detail: Clear the Clockwork Castle through its final encounter.

achievements.name: Secret Ending
achievements.detail: Do the optional work that opens the secret ending, then see it through.
